sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The palace was a popular destination for wedding processions. Nobles made this their home, and mystical beings inhabit the area. Okami warrior women would wear a Dancing Dragon Mask at the palace and dance as an offering for the Divine Dragon, which in turn filled them with vigor.
In order to reach the Palace, one needs to defeat the Corrupted Monk in Mibu Village and the Guardian Ape in the Sunken Valley, then breaking the Iron Code and defeating Great Shinobi - Owl. Once the incense ingredients from these bosses are collected, Wolf can then reenter the Wedding Cave at the end of Mibu Village and be transported to the Palace.

sections.heading: Vermilion Bridge and Mibu Manor
sections.text:
A grand, red bridge leading to the palace grounds, littered with red leaves, guarded by a tall monk.
The bridge leads down to a collection of nobles' homes surrounding a courtyard just outside the palace by a gigantic waterfall and a large lake where the Great Coloured Carp resides.

sections.heading: Sanctuary and Divine Realm
sections.text:
After the palace doors have been opened, the Attendant's second daughter will appear to have entered and stabbed the Palace Nobles to death, having discovered their treachery. After resting, she will have been dead. After the Attendant has been given the Great White Whisker, he will be found at her corpse, later joined by the first daughter.
Atop the hill is the Sanctuary where a maiden sleeps peacefully. Praying here allows Wolf to enter the Divine Realm to fight the Divine Dragon.
